newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy to offer 3.0 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy to offer 3.0 mln common shares.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said Thursday it will sell up to 3.0 million common shares in an underwritten public offering for $39 a share.
Net proceeds estimated at $110.7 million will be used to reduce outstanding debt under bank credit facilities, the company said.
The offering will be made through Salomon Brothers Inc, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Prudential Securities Inc, Morgan Keegan & Co Inc and Southcoast Capital Corp.
KCS is an independent energy company engaged in the acquisition, exploration, development and production of natural gas and crude oil. It is also engaged in natural gas transportation and marketing.
